Usage: astryx theme use [options] <slug>

Choose the app default from its added themes

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the module is regenerated with the selected default
  1  the theme is not added or state is invalid

Examples:
  # Choose the default theme
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme use ocean

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-use
